Architecture Intern - AI Building Design
description:
As an Architecture Intern in our research squad, you help rethink how buildings are designed at comstruct, the AI agent platform that raised a €12.5M seed round from Google Ventures and 20VC and that nine of Switzerland's ten largest contractors already run on. The most important decisions about a building are made early, when little is known, and usually only one or two design options are ever worked out properly. We're building AI agents that explore many design options at once, each detailed enough to price and build. The squad works like a startup within the startup, and you help shape it from day one.

 

🚀 What you'll do

  • Define quality: set the level of detail and quality the design options need for real projects

  • Test against real projects: show the team where AI-generated designs hold up and where they can still improve

  • Deliver the first pilot: help run our first pilot project with a general contractor

  • Work with our engineers: turn your feedback into quality criteria and test cases

     

🚀 What we're looking for

  • Studying architecture or civil engineering, ideally at master's level

  • Hands-on planning experience on real construction projects, e.g. at an architecture or engineering firm or a contractor

  • Curious about AI and excited to rethink how buildings are designed

  • You explain complex topics clearly, also to people without a construction background

  • Structured, thorough and full ownership of your work

  • Full-time internship in our Munich office

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Nice to have: BIM (Revit, Allplan, ArchiCAD), Python or AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)

     

What we offer

  • Real impact: your expertise goes straight into the product and our first pilot

  • Top hardware, daily team dinners and team events

title: AI Engineering Intern
description:
About the role

We’re looking for one AI Engineering Intern to help us build AI systems end-to-end for one of the most complex workflows in European healthcare: procurement. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role for candidates with high agency. At SANOVIO, you will collaborate closely with a small, high-performing team and gain real-world experience building AI-enabled applications in a cross-border B2B environment.

If you're excited about software engineering and AI, this is your opportunity to learn fast, experiment, ship real features, and see your work used in production.

Tasks

  • Work across the full stack to build AI agents and AI-enabled workflows end-to-end

  • Improve search and matching quality for products, suppliers, and documents

  • Build evaluations to measure quality and iterate quickly

  • Build data pipelines to process large-scale unstructured data efficiently

  • Support backend improvements to keep systems scalable, stable, and efficient

  • Improve reliability of AI workflows through structured outputs, tool calling, and guardrails


Qualifications

  • High agency and a builder mindset, you iterate quickly and get things done

  • Experience or strong interest in NLP, LLMs, embeddings, ML, and AI-powered applications

  • First experience with full-stack development, ideally TypeScript and Python, plus React or Next.js

  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and willingness to learn new technologies fast

  • You’re excited to strive for excellence and build software in a fast-paced startup environment

  • You want to work in-person in Munich with more intensity than in a traditional 9–5 role


Benefits

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly wellness budget

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you need to do your best work

  • International scope and real-world operational impact with a return offer chance

  • Flexible work setup with time-zone responsibility

About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce SANOVIO.

Step 2: Technical interview

A take-home technical challenge to showcase your skills, followed by a call to walk us through your approach, insights, and solution for the take-home exercise.

Step 3: Personal Fit

Meet another co-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package.

title: Sezzle: Customer Service Agent
description: Headquarters: Colombia, Remote This is a remote position for candidates based in Bogota, Colombia. About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated Customer Agent who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. Are you passionate about driving customer success? Addicted to solving problems? So are we. We are looking for a customer-driven problem solver at Sezzle. With a fun, genuine, and empathetic voice, you will be troubleshooting and writing clear and concise instructions to solve questions about utilizing Sezzle. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You are dependable, resourceful, and get joy from going beyond to make customers successful. What You'll Do: • Provide clear, prompt, detailed, empathetic, and customer-oriented support to our consumers • Showcase passion and connection with the nooks and crannies product • Assist customers to resolve basic to complex inquiries via email, live chat, and phone call • Build a network of support and trust with our awesome customer support team! • Work with customers to understand how they use Sezzle services, and provide valuable feedback to Product and Development teams • Act as an advocate for our customers, report and act on observed areas for improvement in our product or processes • Actively seek solutions to customer needs, communicate trends to leadership, and suggest innovative solutions on behalf of the customer - experience What We Look For: • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills • Fluent in written and spoken English • Proven success in a fast-paced support environment • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to provide clear, articulate and kind customer support in technical instructions via phone support, email, and live chat • Able to efficiently manage multiple tasks at the same time and utilize personal judgment to take initiative • Driven to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems • Displays a passion for what you do while upholding personal and corporate integrity • Excitement to learn new technologies and help customers succeed • 3+ years of customer support experience • Email, phone and/or live chat experience dealing with complex issues, troubleshooting, and problem resolution, preferably with software • Fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish (a third language is a pre) • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience • Zendesk, LiveAgent or Jira experience is a plus Work Conditions • Remote, work-from-home • Must work from Bogotá, Colombia, can't work outside of the country. • 3-4 training weeks • Full availability first 2 months, no vacations could be approved in this period • Fixed shift, based in Central Standard Time • Competitive salary, bonus structure Compensation and Benefits • Salary: $3.000.000 COP monthly • Benefits: • Remote role About You: • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-customer-service-agent

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, TOLA
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA *Ideal candidates will reside in the Dallas, Austin or Houston area. ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-ai-security-sales-executive-tola

title: SweetSpot Heating and Cooling: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
description: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) • Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). • Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. • Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. • Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. • Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

title: Working Student Legal (AI Infrastructure)
description:
You’ll help build Lyceum’s legal and compliance organisation from the ground up. You work on data protection, AI regulation and the legal questions that come up every day in a fast-growing AI infrastructure startup. Our customers choose a sovereign European GPU cloud because they need to trust how their data and AI workloads are handled. You will turn regulation such as the GDPR, the EU AI Act, and the US CLOUD Act into clear insights and guidelines the whole company can follow.

What You’ll Do

  • Complete Lyceum’s GDPR setup

  • Analyse what key legislations like the EU AI Act, the EU Data Act, and the US CLOUD Act mean for Lyceum’s products, and translate the results into concrete actions and compliance standards

  • Review incoming legal questions from our commercial and finance teams


What We’re Looking For

  • You are a law student in your 7th semester or above, preparing for or having recently completed the First State Examination (Erstes Juristisches Staatsexamen)

  • Your specialisation is in IT, data protection or AI law, or a comparable focus in technology law or IT law

  • You work precisely and carefully: your colleagues can rely on your work being accurate

  • You can explain legal issues clearly and concisely to colleagues without a legal background.

  • You're curious about how technical systems work and how key legislation and regulation apply to them.

  • You have excellent written and spoken English

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week (negotiable) with at least one day per week in our Berlin office


Bonus Points

  • Work experience at a university chair or research group focusing on legislation around data and AI

  • Studies or interest in tech, especially AI and semiconductors

  • Familiarity with compliance standards like C5 and ISO 27001

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech
